description: Hong Kong MTR realtime next-train arrivals at one station on one line, from the Hong Kong government open data feed: direction, destination platform, minutes to next train (ttnt) and scheduled time. Times are the feed's; the feed can be delayed or empty late at night. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

line.description: MTR line code, e.g. TML, TCL, ISL, KTL, TKL (2 to 4 letters)

sta.description: Station code on that line, e.g. TUM, HUH (2 to 4 letters)

name: travel_hk_mtr_realtime
